1	"""Compose AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md for a repository whose main already has an earlier LCV-581 master text.

3	The repository's own sections are taken from the file as it was before the first LCV-581 merge (where the
4	previous master text is an exact prefix), and must also be the exact tail of the current origin/main file.
5	"""
6	import pathlib
7	import subprocess
8	import sys
9	
10	HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
11	OLD = (HERE / "old-master.md").read_bytes()
12	NEW = (HERE / "new-master.md").read_bytes()
13	
14	
15	def git(*args: str) -> bytes:
16	    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout

18

20	    root = pathlib.Path(git("rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").decode().strip())
21	    if root.resolve() != pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve():
22	        raise SystemExit(f"cwd {pathlib.Path.cwd()} is not the repository root {root}")
23	    first = git("log", "origin/main", "--reverse", "--format=%H", "--grep=Refs LCV-581").decode().split()
24	    if not first:
25	        raise SystemExit("no LCV-581 commit found on origin/main")
26	    for name in ("AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"):
27	        before = git("show", f"{first[0]}^:{name}")
28	        if not before.startswith(OLD):
29	            raise SystemExit(f"{name} before {first[0][:12]} does not start with the previous master text")
30	        own = before[len(OLD):]
31	        current = git("show", f"origin/main:{name}")
32	        if not current.endswith(own):
33	            raise SystemExit(f"{name} on origin/main does not end with this repository's own sections")
34	        (root / name).write_bytes(NEW + own)
35	    a, c = (root / "AGENTS.md").read_bytes(), (root / "CLAUDE.md").read_bytes()
36	    if a != c:
37	        raise SystemExit("AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md differ after composing")
38	    print(f"composed {len(a)} bytes ({len(a) - len(NEW)} bytes of repository sections)")
39
